acceptance_gate_result: budget established from this evidence; see budget
machine: designated evaluation host (Intel Core i7-10700, 31 GiB RAM, Debian 13)
method: sequential managed single-record body edits through plan_mdbase_write and apply_mdbase_write_profiled (no auto-commit) on the public fixtures, without readers; after each write a watched MdbaseQuerySession reads the record's metadata and must show the new revision; the first write (one-time state) and the restoring write are excluded; nearest-rank percentiles

concurrent.note: writes at two per second while eight readers share one watched session

budget.scope: single-record managed write on the 10K reference fixture, plan through apply including durable journal, record-cache publication, and note indexing
budget.basis: measured p95 137 ms single-client, 222 ms under eight readers, following read 11.4 ms; roughly 1.4-2x headroom for host variance
not_covered: collection-wide uniqueness or validated-link rules (constraints fixture)
100K, which is a scaling case: p95 953 ms, dominated by record-cache publication (385 ms p50)
